title: Your notes. Your space.
summary: Offline profiles, optional cloud sync, and more ways to take your notes with you.

items: Create an offline profile and keep your notes on this device.
Export a Scribe backup or Markdown, and import notes into another workspace.
Find update controls and What’s New in Settings → About.
Cloud sync is optional, with a clear explanation before you enable it.
Each workspace keeps its own notes and preferences.
Reading mode keeps your place when switching from editing.
Review the data being removed before deleting workspace data or an account.
